descriptionFull: The American woodcock ( Scolopax minor ), sometimes colloquially referred to as the timberdoodle , is a small chunky shorebird species found primarily in the eastern half of North America. Woodcocks spend most of their time on the ground in brushy, young-forest habitats, where the birds' brown, black, and gray plumage provides excellent camouflage.
